text.en: Pet owners consistently commend the team at PetsnVets in Crookfur for their kind, considerate, and attentive approach. Longstanding clients highlight that both veterinary surgeons and support staff maintain high standards of patient care and customer service. Reviewers frequently describe the practice atmosphere as welcoming, reassuring, and thoroughly helpful throughout each visit.

Clients emphasize the gentle and patient handling their animals receive during clinical checkups and consultations. Reviewers with particularly nervous cats and dogs share that the clinicians take extra time to calm and comfort pets during physical examinations. Pet parents report that their dogs genuinely enjoy visiting the surgery thanks to the caring and friendly treatment provided.

Visitors praise the surgery environment on Corrour Road in Newton Mearns for being exceptionally clean, well maintained, and pleasant. Pet owners appreciate the calm neighbourhood setting and organised consultation rooms that make veterinary visits straightforward and relaxing. Reviewers note that the practice provides a thoroughly professional and reliable facility for local pets.

q.en: How does the practice handle nervous pets?

a.en: Reviewers note that the veterinary surgeons take extra time and use gentle techniques to help nervous cats and dogs feel calm and secure.

q.en: Can appointments be booked online at Crookfur?

a.en: Yes, clients can book routine veterinary and nurse consultations online through the PetsnVets website.

q.en: Does the practice provide emergency veterinary care?

a.en: Urgent care is available during opening hours, with hospitalisation and out-of-hours emergencies supported by The Roundhouse Veterinary Hospital.
